scope: The standing Church of Our Lady of Mount Carmel in Ouro Preto, including its curved Rococo frontispiece, rounded bell towers, tiled nave and rear range, and the principal stone approach stair.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: IPHAN describes the concave-convex-concave front, rounded square towers with corner pilasters, stone carving and the straight laterally viewed main body.
Architectural analysis describes the curving cornice, low oculus between choir windows, twin inset curved towers, and a crown and Carmel escutcheon on the pediment.
